title: M1 Read the learned state and per-version provenance
description: Read API plus hosted operation for a classifier's current and past learned state (rubric, supporting questions, head weights, example ids, version, fingerprint). Per-version provenance by joining each classifier-activated snapshot to the optimizer-request/response, proposal-validated (rationale), promotion result and training_evidence ids that produced it.
